borderColor.help: Leave empty to use the brand color.

brandColor.help: Overrides the site brand color for this block.

textColor.help: Overrides body and label ink. Leave empty to derive from the background.

blockTitleColor.help: Ink for the large title beside the image. Leave empty to follow the body text colour.

labelColor.help: Ink for every label. An item with its own Label Color overrides this. Leave empty to derive from the background.

valueColor.help: Ink for every value. An item with its own Value Color overrides this. Leave empty to derive from the background.

itemTextColor.help: Ink for every point's description. Leave empty to derive from the background.

bulletTitleColor.help: Ink for every bullet title. Leave empty to derive from the background.

bulletTextColor.help: Ink for every bullet description. Leave empty to derive from the background.

bulletCheckColor.help: Fill behind every bullet's tick. Leave empty to follow the block's accent color.

statValueColor.help: Ink for every inline stat value. Leave empty to derive from the background.

statLabelColor.help: Ink for every inline stat label. Leave empty to derive from the background.

timelineBaseColor.help: Fill behind each milestone marker. White by default so the markers read against any background. The ring around them follows the block's background on its own.

timelineMarkerInk.help: The number or check inside each marker. Set this when a dark Marker Base needs a light symbol over it.

iconColor.help: Ink for every item icon. Plain tints the glyph itself; Tile and Circle use it as the backdrop with a white glyph over it. An item with its own Icon Color overrides this.

accentColor.help: The block's second brand color. It is the second stop of the Brand Gradient and Accent Top Bar card styles, the hero's glow washes and heading highlight, accent pills, timeline dots, non-featured pricing buttons, and the accent ink on a dark background.

backgroundMidColor.help: Optional third color the gradient passes through at 55%.

backgroundAccentColor.help: The color the gradient finishes on, starting from the Background. Leave empty to fade into a darker shade of the background, or into the accent color when no background color is set.

tableBadgeBackground.help: Used by any column set to the Badge display.

headerGap.help: The gap between the heading and the content under it. None puts the content right under the heading.

width.help: Blocks stay inside their container by default. Full Bleed and Inset Band break out to the viewport, so only use them in a full width region.

labelSize.help: Scales every stat title relative to the block's body text. A stat with its own Title Size overrides this.

valueSize.help: Scales every stat value relative to the block's body text. Default follows the treatment: display scale in a row, body scale in tiles and inline. A stat with its own Value Size overrides this.

backgroundGradient.help: Direction the background fades into the background accent. Works with or without a background color.

backgroundOverlay.help: Tint layered over the background image so headings and copy stay readable. Only paints when a background image is set.

backgroundOverlayColor.help: Leave empty to tint with the block's own background, or a deep navy when that is light. The opacity applies to the Custom overlay; the other recipes carry their own.

carouselInterval.help: How long each slide holds. Auto-advance pauses on hover, stops while the block is off screen, and stops entirely for visitors who prefer reduced motion. Arrows, dots and swipe always work.

imageCaption.help: Where the image's title and description render, or whether they render at all.

backgroundEffect.help: Movement applied to the background image. Both effects play in the builder and on the site, and stop for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

backgroundParallaxSpeed.help: How far the photo lags the page as the block scrolls past.

contentPosition.help: Where the copy sits in the block's vertical space. Only has an effect once a Block Height is set.

blockHeight.help: Minimum height for image-led blocks. Content taller than the preset grows the block rather than being cut off.

backgroundTexture.help: Faint pattern layered over the background, whatever the background is.

statsTreatment.help: One named layout for the row. Blocks saved with the old layout knobs open on the matching treatment and keep rendering until a new one is picked.

entrance.help: Plays once as the block scrolls into view, never on revisit. Keep one entrance style per page.

hoverStyle.help: Pointer feedback for the block's items. Use it only when they actually link somewhere.

headerPlacement.help: Across the top runs the heading the full width, with the body and the media side by side under it.

buttonPlacement.help: With the heading keeps the buttons above the two columns. Under the copy ends the copy's column with them.

factsDisplay.help: Rows is the At-a-glance card. Bars reads each value as a percentage.

heroMedia.help: What sits beside the copy: the image, a Facts panel, a Timeline, Bullets, or nothing.

timelineOrientation.help: Horizontal is the cycle stepper; vertical is the process journey.

cardLayout.help: Inline puts the icon beside the title for compact chips.

verticalAlign.help: How the two columns align against each other: start, center, end, or stretch to fill the row.

splitRatio.help: Balance of the two columns in any side-by-side arrangement.

showcaseItems.help: Cards renders each item as its own small panel instead of a ticked bullet.

cardMedia.help: How an item's Icon Image URL renders. Cover ignores the icon backdrop.

iconStyle.help: Backdrop behind each item icon, tinted with the brand color. Circle renders solid brand with a white glyph.

iconSize.help: Small suits checklist rows; Large is the feature-icon default.

imageFit.help: Fill crops the image to the space it sits in. Fit keeps the whole image and may leave room around it.

imageBleed.help: Lets artwork run past the section padding.
